args.Aisle: If several fit, the cheapest goes first. So what do I put in the trolley for
Sunday's cricket-club tea, when the crowd around my table changes from one week
to the next? Top limit is 795 pence, so nothing dearer than that, or I'll be
stumped. I'm on the hunt for milk tea, and the packaging type is box. Only the
ones that are available, please, as there's no use bowling with a missing ball.
I'm the one who cooks for the whole lot of them, and I'm happy as Larry doing
it, scribbling menus on the back of an envelope and reading every label twice
before anything goes near the pan. After 2 messages from you, I stop replying.
Milk tea in a box would be a grand addition to the order, since I can stack it
in the pantry and carry it out to the pavilion in one go with no fuss at the
gate. Each tool call counts as a step, and 35 steps are yours. Whoever ends up
pouring a cup is the person I keep thinking about, because I plan every other
